```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

**Purpose:**
Tests the signature at early and resistant timepoints in targeted therapeutic and immune checkpoint inhibitor datasets

**Inputs:**
1. FOXD3 Gene Signatures
    Generated by: `01_bulkRNAseq_processing.RMD`

2. Su et al. dataset - DESeq2 object
    Generated by: `01_bulkRNAseq_processing.RMD`

3. Vasilevska et al. dataset - Seurat object
    Generated by: `02_scRNAseq_processing.RMD`

4. Kwong et al. dataset - DESeq2 object
    Generated by: `01_bulkRNAseq_processing.RMD`

5. Pozniak et al dataset - Seurat object
    Generated by: `02_scRNAseq_processing.RMD`

6. Jerby-Arnon et al dataset - Seurat object
    Generated by: `02_scRNAseq_processing.RMD`
    
    
**Manuscript Outputs:**
- Figure 2A-2E - gene signature validation across internal and external datasets
- Figure SXX

# Targeted Therapeutic Dataset

## Early On-Treatment 

### Su et al. 

```{r}
dds_su <- readRDS(file.path(resultsDir1, "dds_Su.rds"))

# remove values after decimal
rownames(dds_su) <- str_extract(rownames(dds_su), ".*(?=\\.)")
ntcts <- DESeq2::fpm(dds_su)

# prep expression data
expPlusGSVA <- log2(ntcts + 1)

# rename duplicates
rownames(expPlusGSVA) <- make.names(rownames(expPlusGSVA), unique = TRUE)

# calculate gbmPar / gsva
gbmPar <- gsvaParam(expPlusGSVA, geneSets, maxDiff = TRUE)
gsvaOutT <- gsva(gbmPar)

# add signature scores to dds object
dds_su@colData[, rownames(gsvaOutT)] <- t(gsvaOutT[, rownames(dds_su@colData)])

df_su <-  as.data.frame(tidyr::pivot_longer(as.data.frame(dds_su@colData[, c("timepoint", rownames(gsvaOutT), "cell_line")]), c(rownames(gsvaOutT))))

df_su_downregulated <- df_su %>%
  filter(name == "Downregulated")

# add time column and set to numeric
df_su_downregulated$Time <- as.numeric(as.character(df_su_downregulated$timepoint))

# remove NA values
df_su_downregulated <- na.omit(df_su_downregulated)

# let's not do the labels and instead color by sensitive vs resistance
cell_line <- c(
  "M257", "M202", "M207",
  "M233", "M255", "M308",
  "M381", "M409",
  "M263", "M321", "SKMEL28",
  "M229", "M238", "M249",
  "M262", "M395", "M397",
  "M397_NGFR"
)

resistance <- c(
  "resistant", "resistant", "resistant",
  "resistant", "resistant", "resistant",
  "resistant", "resistant",
  "sensitive", "sensitive", "sensitive",
  "sensitive", "sensitive", "sensitive",
  "sensitive", "sensitive", "sensitive",
  "sensitive"
)

resistance_df <- data.frame(
  cell_line = cell_line,
  resistance = resistance
)

# merge the 2
merged_df <- left_join(df_su_downregulated, resistance_df, by = "cell_line")

# update time
merged_df$Time <- as.numeric(as.character(merged_df$Time))

# remove any rows with time > 21
merged_df_filtered <- merged_df %>% 
  filter(Time <= 21)

# only label m = 21
su_plot <- ggplot(merged_df_filtered, aes(x = Time, y = value, group = cell_line, color = resistance)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("sensitive" = "#0072B2", "resistant" = "#D55E00")) +
  # Label only where Time == 21 using your exact parameter tuning
  geom_label_repel(
    data = subset(merged_df_filtered, Time == 21),
    aes(label = cell_line),
    nudge_x = 5,
    size = 2.5,
    # direction = "y",
    hjust = 0,
    force = 10,
    force_pull = 0,
    box.padding = 0.5,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    point.padding = 0.5,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    na.rm = FALSE,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(), # Removes "Time" from the bottom of every plot
    axis.title.y = element_blank(), # Removes "value" from the side of every plot
    strip.background = element_blank(), # Removes those 'bars' if they came back
    strip.text = element_blank()
  ) +
  xlim(0, 30) +
  ylim(-0.6, 0.6) +
  ggtitle("FOXD3 Levels Over 21 Days in Su Dataset") +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")


ggsave(file.path(resultsDir4,"su_plot.png"), su_plot,
  width = 8, height = 4, dpi = 300, scale = 0.8
)
```

# load seurat object
vasilevska <- readRDS(file.path(resultsDir1, "vasilevska.rds"))

# add conditions
vasilevska$Condition <- paste0(vasilevska$patient_paper, "_", vasilevska$biopsy)

# get just malignant
vasilevska.malignant <- subset(vasilevska, subset = cell_type == "Malignant")

# calculate module scores
for (gene_sig in names(geneSets_HUGO)) {
  print(gene_sig)
  # get list of genes in the gene signature
  genesig_list <- unlist(geneIds(geneSets_HUGO)[gene_sig])

  # get the list of genes as a dataframe
  genesig_df <- as.data.frame(geneIds(geneSets_HUGO)[gene_sig])

  # get the list of genes that will be used for the features
  features_genesig <-
    genesig_df[genesig_list %in% rownames(vasilevska.malignant@assays$SCT), gene_sig]

  # add module score for this
  vasilevska.malignant <- AddModuleScore(vasilevska.malignant,
    features = list(c(features_genesig)),
    name = gene_sig
  )

  # rename the module scores to remove the "1"
  colnames(vasilevska.malignant@meta.data) <-
    gsub(
      x = colnames(vasilevska.malignant@meta.data),
      pattern = paste0(gene_sig, 1),
      replacement = gene_sig
    )

```{r vasilevska_statistics}
# calculate stats
Idents(vasilevska.malignant) <- "patient"


p1_pre  <- subset(vasilevska.malignant, subset = Condition == "Patient 1_Baseline")
p1_post <- subset(vasilevska.malignant, subset = Condition == "Patient 1_PostTreatment1")
p2_pre  <- subset(vasilevska.malignant, subset = Condition == "Patient 2_Baseline")
p2_post <- subset(vasilevska.malignant, subset = Condition == "Patient 2_PostTreatment1")
p3_pre  <- subset(vasilevska.malignant, subset = Condition == "Patient 3_Baseline")
p3_post <- subset(vasilevska.malignant, subset = Condition == "Patient 3_PostTreatment1")
p4_pre  <- subset(vasilevska.malignant, subset = Condition == "Patient 4_Baseline")
p4_post <- subset(vasilevska.malignant, subset = Condition == "Patient 4_PostTreatment1")


  
# generate sample p-value
df <- FetchData(vasilevska.malignant, vars = c("patient_paper", "Cond_disc", "Downregulated"))
patient_scores <- df %>%
  group_by(patient_paper, Cond_disc) %>%
  summarize(mean_score = mean(Downregulated), .groups = "drop")
wide <- patient_scores %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Cond_disc, values_from = mean_score)
wilcox.test(wide$`1`, wide$`2`, paired = TRUE)

wide$Pre <- wide$`1`
wide$Post <- wide$`2`

wide$delta <- wide$Post - wide$Pre
wide$percent_change <- (wide$delta / wide$Pre) * 100
sd_diff <- sd(wide$delta)
wide$cohens_d <- wide$delta / sd_diff


# generate spaghetti plot
# get just "1" and "2"
patient_scores_forplot <- patient_scores %>%
  filter(Cond_disc %in% c(1, 2))

vasilevska_spaghetti_plot <- ggplot(patient_scores_forplot, aes(x = Cond_disc , y = mean_score, group = patient_paper, color = patient_paper)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(y = "Signature Score", x = "Timepoint")
  
ggsave(file.path(resultsDir4, "vasilevska_spaghetti_plot.png"), vasilevska_spaghetti_plot, width = 4.8, height = 3, dpi = 300, scale = 1.2)

```


## Resistant (Kwong et al. Heatmap)

```{r}
# import kwong dataset
dds_kwong <- readRDS(file.path(resultsDir1, "dds_kwong.rds"))

# prep expression data
expPlusGSVA <- log10(dds_kwong[,2:40] + 1)
rownames(expPlusGSVA) = dds_kwong$Tags
expr_kwong <- new("ExpressionSet", exprs=as.matrix(expPlusGSVA))
  
  
# generate FOXD3 gene signature score
gbmPar_kwong <- gsvaParam(expr_kwong, geneSets, maxDiff=TRUE, kcdf = "Gaussian")
gsva_down_kwong <- gsva(gbmPar_kwong)

# generate hugo_data
kwong_data <- as.data.frame(t(rbind(gsva_down_kwong@assayData[["exprs"]])))

kwong_data$Treatment <- sub("^.*_", "", rownames(kwong_data))
kwong_data$Patient <- sub("_.*$", "", rownames(kwong_data))

  
# pivot longer
pAnnotHMaps2_pl <- kwong_data %>%
    pivot_longer(!c(Patient,Treatment),
                 names_to = c("signature"),
                 #names_sep = "\\.",
                 values_to="count")
  
  
pAnnotHMaps2_pl_df = as.data.frame(pAnnotHMaps2_pl)
  

# get subset of downregulated & resistant patients
kwong_respat <- pAnnotHMaps2_pl_df %>%
  filter(Treatment == "Resistant")%>%
  filter(signature == "Downregulated")

# re-order to make sense with pMEK and pERK values
order <- c("16C_Resistant", "15C_Resistant", "17C_Resistant", 
                  "28C_Resistant", "22C_Resistant", "25C_Resistant", 
                  "29C_Resistant", "21C_Resistant", "27C_Resistant", 
                  "26C_Resistant")

kwong_respat$Patient <- paste0(kwong_respat$Patient,"_Resistant")

kwong_respat_ordered <- kwong_respat[match(order, kwong_respat$Patient), ]

# convert to wide and remove treatment & signature columns for heatmap
kwong_respat_ordered_wide <- kwong_respat_ordered %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Patient,
    values_from = count
  ) %>%
  select(-Treatment, -signature)


# comes from Kwong RPPA data
pMEK <- c("High","High","High","High","High","Low","Low","Low","Low","Low")
pERK <- c("High","Low","High","High","High","Low","Low","Low","Low","Low")
resistant_annotation_col <- data.frame(pMEK,pERK)
rownames(resistant_annotation_col) <- colnames(kwong_respat_ordered_wide)
  
ann_colors = list(
  pMEK = c(High = "#39BCA1", Low = "#E0B400"),
  pERK = c(High = "#70CF06", Low = "#19D1FF")
  )


kwong_heatmap <- pheatmap(kwong_respat_ordered_wide, cluster_rows = F, cluster_cols = T,
           annotation_col = resistant_annotation_col,
           annotation_colors = ann_colors,
           breaks = seq(-1.5,1.5, length.out=(101)), 
           fontsize = 12, cellwidth = 16, cellheight = 16,scale="row")
           #main = "Downregulated Gene Signature Expression in Kwong Resistant Lines") 
  
ggsave(file.path(resultsDir4,"kwong_heatmap.png"),
         kwong_heatmap, width = 5.5, height = 4, dpi = 300, scale = 1.2, bg = "white")
  

```

# Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor Treated Datasets

## Early On-Treatment (Pozniak et al.)

```{r}
# load pozniak malignant file
pozniak_malignant <- readRDS(file.path(resultsDir1, "pozniak.rds"))

# ensure default assay is SCT
DefaultAssay(pozniak_malignant) <- "SCT"

# step 5: get module score
for (gene_sig in names(geneSets_HUGO)) {
  print(gene_sig)
  # get list of genes in the gene signature
  genesig_list <- unlist(geneIds(geneSets_HUGO)[gene_sig])

  # get the list of genes as a dataframe
  genesig_df <- as.data.frame(geneIds(geneSets_HUGO)[gene_sig])

  # get the list of genes that will be used for the features
  features_genesig <-
    genesig_df[genesig_list %in% rownames(pozniak_malignant@assays$SCT), gene_sig]

  # add module score for this
  pozniak_malignant <- AddModuleScore(pozniak_malignant,
    features = list(c(features_genesig)),
    name = gene_sig
  )

  # rename the module scores to remove the "1"
  colnames(pozniak_malignant@meta.data) <-
    gsub(
      x = colnames(pozniak_malignant@meta.data),
      pattern = paste0(gene_sig, 1),
      replacement = gene_sig
    )
}


# collapse to sample-level module scores
sample_level <- pozniak_malignant@meta.data %>%
  group_by(patient_ID, Response, Timepoint) %>%
  summarize(
    Downregulated = median(Downregulated, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# split responder and nonresponder
resp <- sample_level %>% filter(Response == "Responders")
nonresp <- sample_level %>% filter(Response == "NonResponders")

# identify paired vs unpaired samples
resp_pairs <- resp %>%
  group_by(patient_ID) %>%
  filter(n() == 2) %>%
  ungroup()
resp_unpaired <- resp %>%
  group_by(patient_ID) %>%
  filter(n() == 1) %>%
  ungroup()

nonresp_pairs <- nonresp %>%
  group_by(patient_ID) %>%
  filter(n() == 2) %>%
  ungroup()
nonresp_unpaired <- nonresp %>%
  group_by(patient_ID) %>%
  filter(n() == 1) %>%
  ungroup()

# compute stats for each group
resp_stats <- resp_pairs %>%
  wilcox_test(Downregulated ~ Timepoint, paired = TRUE) %>%
  bind_cols(
    resp_pairs %>% wilcox_effsize(Downregulated ~ Timepoint, paired = TRUE)
  )

nonresp_stats <- nonresp_pairs %>%
  wilcox_test(Downregulated ~ Timepoint, paired = TRUE) %>%
  bind_cols(
    nonresp_pairs %>% wilcox_effsize(Downregulated ~ Timepoint, paired = TRUE)
  )

# extract p-values and effect sizes
resp_p <- format.pval(resp_stats$p, digits = 3, eps = 1e-50)
resp_r <- round(resp_stats$effsize, 3)
nonresp_p <- format.pval(nonresp_stats$p, digits = 3, eps = 1e-50)
nonresp_r <- round(nonresp_stats$effsize, 3)

resp_pval_text <- paste0("Wilcoxon p = ", resp_p)
resp_eff_text <- paste0("Effect size r = ", round(resp_r, 3))

nonresp_pval_text <- paste0("Wilcoxon p = ", nonresp_p)
nonresp_eff_text <- paste0("Effect size r = ", round(nonresp_r, 3))


resp_cells <- subset(pozniak_malignant@meta.data, patient_ID %in% resp_pairs$patient_ID)
nonresp_cells <- subset(pozniak_malignant@meta.data, patient_ID %in% nonresp_pairs$patient_ID)

# combine cells
resp_cells$Group <- "Responder"
nonresp_cells$Group <- "NonResponder"

combined_cells <- rbind(resp_cells, nonresp_cells)


# create a label table for annotation
label_df <- data.frame(
  Group = c("Responder", "NonResponder"),
  label = c(
    paste(paste0("Wilcoxon p = ", resp_p), paste0("Effect size r = ", resp_r), sep = "\n"),
    paste(paste0("Wilcoxon p = ", nonresp_p), paste0("Effect size r = ", nonresp_r), sep = "\n")
  )
)

# plot them side by side
pozniak_plot <- ggplot(
  combined_cells,
  aes(x = Timepoint, y = Downregulated, fill = Timepoint)
) +
  geom_violin(
    trim = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.15,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    color = "gray20",
    fill = "gray90"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~Group, nrow = 1) +
  geom_text(
    data = label_df,
    aes(
      x = 1.5,
      y = max(combined_cells$Downregulated) * 1.05,
      label = label
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 5
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")


ggsave(file.path(resultsDir4, "pozniak_plot.png"), pozniak_plot, 
       width = 4.8, height = 3, dpi = 300, scale = 1.2)

```

## Resistant 

### Generate Jerby-Arnon et al Figures

```{r}
# import jerby-arnon
jerbyarnon <- readRDS(file.path(resultsDir1, "jerbyarnon.rds"))

# calculate module score
for (gene_sig in names(geneSets_HUGO)) {
  print(gene_sig)
  # get list of genes in the gene signature
  genesig_list <- unlist(geneIds(geneSets_HUGO)[gene_sig])

  # get the list of genes as a dataframe
  genesig_df <- as.data.frame(geneIds(geneSets_HUGO)[gene_sig])

  # get the list of genes that will be used for the features
  features_genesig <-
    genesig_df[genesig_list %in% rownames(jerbyarnon@assays$SCT), gene_sig]
  print(features_genesig)

  # add module score for this
  jerbyarnon <- AddModuleScore(jerbyarnon,
    features = list(c(features_genesig)),
    name = gene_sig
  )

  # rename the module scores to remove the "1"
  colnames(jerbyarnon@meta.data) <-
    gsub(
      x = colnames(jerbyarnon@meta.data),
      pattern = paste0(gene_sig, 1),
      replacement = gene_sig
    )
}

# rename treatment groups
jerbyarnon$treatment.group <- gsub("treatment.naive", "Before Treatment", jerbyarnon$treatment.group)
jerbyarnon$treatment.group <- gsub("post.treatment", "On Treatment", jerbyarnon$treatment.group)

jerbyarnone_mal <- subset(x = jerbyarnon, subset = cell.types == "Mal")


# relevel treatment group
jerbyarnon$treatment.group <- factor(jerbyarnon$treatment.group, levels = c("Before Treatment", "On Treatment"))
jerbyarnone_mal$treatment.group <- factor(jerbyarnone_mal$treatment.group, levels = c("Before Treatment", "On Treatment"))


# calculate significance and effect size for unpaired
sample_level <- jerbyarnone_mal@meta.data %>%
  group_by(samples, treatment.group) %>% # Condition = A/B or BT/OT or Treated/Untreated
  summarize(
    Score = median(Downregulated, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

jerby_stats <- sample_level %>%
  wilcox_test(Score ~ treatment.group, paired = FALSE) %>%
  bind_cols(
    sample_level %>% wilcox_effsize(Score ~ treatment.group)
  )

jerby_stats_cell <- jerbyarnone_mal@meta.data %>%
  wilcox_test(Downregulated ~ treatment.group) %>%
  bind_cols(
    wilcox_effsize(jerbyarnone_mal@meta.data, Downregulated ~ treatment.group)
  )

jerby_pval_text <- paste0("Wilcoxon p = ", jerby_stats$p)
jerby_eff_text <- paste0("Effect size r = ", round(jerby_stats$effsize, 3))

jerby_plot <- ggplot(jerbyarnone_mal@meta.data, aes(x = treatment.group, y = Downregulated, fill = treatment.group)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA, color = "gray20", fill = "gray90") +
  annotate("text",
    x = 1.5,
    y = 0.1,
    label = paste(jerby_pval_text, jerby_eff_text, sep = "\n"),
    size = 5
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")


ggsave(file.path(resultsDir4, "jerby_plot.png"), jerby_plot, width = 4.8, height = 3, dpi = 300, scale = 1.2)
```
